title: Demonic Muse in Studio
description: A bearded man with long dark hair looks up from the foreground in a decorated room filled with colorful swirling light trails. Above him a dark demonic silhouette with glowing pink eyes and large horns hovers beneath an ornate golden crown chandelier, surrounded by floating papers on a vibrant blue ceiling with fleur-de-lis patterns and lit candles.
